setting: You both live in Melbourne, in the inner north and west, and you were together for six years before splitting up this spring. You know each other's habits well, from who leaves dishes in the sink to who handles the bills. You are both still friendly enough to text about practical things. Your last exchange was a short chat about whether the Saturday footy result had been reported correctly.
opener: Message Liam asking whether he'd keep the cat and split the vet bills.

situation: My ex and I, sorting out who keeps the cat.

text: hey. random q but would you be ok keeping the cat for now and we split the vet bills? i know it's a lot to ask. i can do the litter tray if that helps lol
Yeah that's fine.
Split the vet bills too. Is it the scratch thing or the annual?
annual. plus the scratch thing is apparently 'a bit more than a scratch' according to the vet so there's that
Still on the same food?
yes. she will not eat the other one, i tried. don't buy the cheap stuff
Wasn't going to.
Did the Dockers thing make the paper? Saw something about a review on the radio
no idea. i'm not watching footy anymore, you know that
you can look it up, i know you want to
Ha. Yeah, looked it up. Think the report was fair.
the report was not fair, the umpire was an idiot
Umpire was a bit of an idiot. Fair enough.
are you going to be home tonight? i need to drop the cat's carrier off, it's still at mine
Not till about five. Can you leave it with Dan if I'm not back
He's in most of the day
yep. i'll message him. tell him not to put it in the garage
Home. Dan says the carrier's in the hallway. Thanks
Didn't go in the garage
home. dan says hi apparently. he's been hiding the carrier behind the bin
He's been using it as a footstool
of course he has
Cat's sitting in it now. Took about four seconds
she does that. she's not allowed to be proud of it
did you ever end up getting the bin bags I asked for
Yeah they're under the sink. The cheap ones
Wasn't going to buy the cheap ones
morning. the vet emailed about the annual, sending you the invoice tonight
Ok. Is she still on the tablets for her teeth or did they finish
finished in october. she's been fine
she's been a bit fat tho. you've been feeding her off the plate haven't you
Not on purpose
Dan's cooked a roast. He's asking if you want to come round Thursday. He says the gravy's a disaster but he's proud of the potatoes
tell him the potatoes are only ok if they're par boiled first. i'm not coming for gravy
He says that's not a no
i'm home. lol the carrier is still in the hallway from tuesday, you said dan would move it
He moved it to the back step. Cat's on it now
ok good she likes the back step. don't let her out
